results.name: Polynomial.monic_prod_of_monic
results.source_text:
theorem monic_prod_of_monic (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → R[X]) (hs : ∀ i ∈ s, Monic (f i)) :
    Monic (∏ i ∈ s, f i) :=
  monic_multiset_prod_of_monic s.1 f hs

results.name: Polynomial.monic_multiset_prod_of_monic
results.source_text:
theorem monic_multiset_prod_of_monic (t : Multiset ι) (f : ι → R[X]) (ht : ∀ i ∈ t, Monic (f i)) :
    Monic (t.map f).prod := by
  revert ht
  refine t.induction_on ?_ ?_; · simp
  intro a t ih ht
  rw [Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.prod_cons]
  exact (ht _ (Multiset.mem_cons_self _ _)).mul (ih fun _ hi => ht _ (Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem hi))

results.name: Polynomial.Monic
results.docstring: a polynomial is `Monic` if its leading coefficient is 1

results.name: Polynomial.Monic.mul
results.source_text:
theorem Monic.mul (hp : Monic p) (hq : Monic q) : Monic (p * q) :=
  letI := Classical.decEq R
  if h0 : (0 : R) = 1 then
    haveI := subsingleton_of_zero_eq_one h0
    Subsingleton.elim _ _
  else by
    have : p.leadingCoeff * q.leadingCoeff ≠ 0 := by
      simp [Monic.def.1 hp, Monic.def.1 hq, Ne.symm h0]
    rw [Monic.def, leadingCoeff_mul' this, Monic.def.1 hp, Monic.def.1 hq, one_mul]

results.name: MonomialOrder.Monic.mul
results.source_text:
theorem Monic.mul {f g : MvPolynomial σ R} (hf : m.Monic f) (hg : m.Monic g) :
    m.Monic (f * g) := by
  nontriviality R
  suffices m.leadingCoeff f * m.leadingCoeff g = 1 by
    rw [Monic, MonomialOrder.leadingCoeff,
      degree_mul_of_mul_leadingCoeff_ne_zero, coeff_mul_of_degree_add, this]
    rw [this]
    exact one_ne_zero
  rw [hf.leadingCoeff_eq_one, hg.leadingCoeff_eq_one, one_mul]

results.name: Finset.sum_comm'

@[to_additive /-- Generalization of `Finset.sum_comm` to the case when the inner `Finset`s depend on
the outer variable. -/]
theorem prod_comm' {s : Finset γ} {t : γ → Finset α} {t' : Finset α} {s' : α → Finset γ}
    (h : ∀ x y, x ∈ s ∧ y ∈ t x ↔ x ∈ s' y ∧ y ∈ t') {f : γ → α → β} :
    (∏ x ∈ s, ∏ y ∈ t x, f x y) = ∏ y ∈ t', ∏ x ∈ s' y, f x y := by

Generalization of `Finset.sum_comm` to the case when the inner `Finset`s depend on
the outer variable.

results.name: Finsupp.prod_attach_index
results.source_text:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma prod_attach_index [CommMonoid N] {s : Finset α} (f : α → M) {h : α → M → N} :
    ∏ x ∈ s.attach, h x (f x) = ∏ x ∈ s, h x (f x) :=
  prod_attach _ fun x ↦ h x (f x)

results.name: finsum
results.source_text:
/-- Sum of `f x` as `x` ranges over the elements of the support of `f`, if it's finite. Zero
otherwise. -/
noncomputable irreducible_def finsum (lemma := finsum_def') [AddCommMonoid M] (f : α → M) : M :=
  if h : HasFiniteSupport (f ∘ PLift.down) then ∑ i ∈ h.toFinset, f i.down else 0
results.docstring:
Sum of `f x` as `x` ranges over the elements of the support of `f`, if it's finite. Zero
otherwise.

results.name: Nat.mem_divisors
results.source_text:
@[simp, grind =]
theorem mem_divisors {m : ℕ} : n ∈ divisors m ↔ n ∣ m ∧ m ≠ 0 := by
  rcases eq_or_ne m 0 with (rfl | hm); · simp [divisors]
  simp only [hm, Ne, not_false_iff, and_true, ← filter_dvd_eq_divisors hm, mem_filter,
    mem_range, and_iff_right_iff_imp, Nat.lt_succ_iff]
  exact le_of_dvd hm.bot_lt

results.name: Nat.divisors
results.source_text:
/-- `divisors n` is the `Finset` of divisors of `n`. By convention, we set `divisors 0 = ∅`. -/
def divisors : Finset ℕ := {d ∈ Ico 1 (n + 1) | d ∣ n}
results.docstring: `divisors n` is the `Finset` of divisors of `n`. By convention, we set `divisors 0 = ∅`.

results.name: Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors
results.source_text: theorem dvd_of_mem_divisors {m : ℕ} (h : n ∈ divisors m) : n ∣ m := (mem_divisors.mp h).1

results.name: Nat.mem_divisorsAntidiagonal
results.source_text:
@[simp]
theorem mem_divisorsAntidiagonal {x : ℕ × ℕ} :
    x ∈ divisorsAntidiagonal n ↔ x.fst * x.snd = n ∧ n ≠ 0 := by
  obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := x
  simp only [divisorsAntidiagonal, mul_div_eq_iff_dvd, mem_filterMap, mem_Icc, one_le_iff_ne_zero,
    Option.ite_none_right_eq_some, Option.some.injEq, Prod.ext_iff, and_left_comm, exists_eq_left]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨han, ⟨ha, han'⟩, rfl⟩
    simp [Nat.mul_div_eq_iff_dvd, han]
    lia
  · rintro ⟨rfl, hab⟩
    rw [mul_ne_zero_iff] at hab
    simpa [hab.1, hab.2] using Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ hab.2.bot_lt

results.name: Nat.ne_zero_of_mem_divisors
results.source_text: theorem ne_zero_of_mem_divisors {m : ℕ} (h : n ∈ divisors m) : m ≠ 0 := (mem_divisors.mp h).2

results.name: Physlib.PiTensorProduct.instAddCommMonoidElim_physlib
results.source_text:
/-- Given two maps `s1` and `s2` whose targets carry an instance of an additive commutative
  monoid, the target of the sum of these two maps also carry an instance thereof. -/
instance : (i : ι1 ⊕ ι2) → AddCommMonoid ((fun i => Sum.elim s1 s2 i) i) := fun i =>
  match i with
  | Sum.inl i => inst1 i
  | Sum.inr i => inst2 i
results.docstring:
Given two maps `s1` and `s2` whose targets carry an instance of an additive commutative
monoid, the target of the sum of these two maps also carry an instance thereof.
